title: Narra 4.1.0
message: This release tightens account security, anime discovery and downloads, Profile personalization, and Premium media access.
changelog: Added signed startup verification, Firebase identity checks, device limits and live Premium expiry state.
Profile Home, Discover and expanded-source settings now change the active app experience immediately.
Expanded anime search and provider recovery, with episode names, SUB/DUB choices and subtitles.
Moved anime downloads to individual episode rows with progress and a five-file free allowance; donors remain unlimited.
Added a Premium Asian Drama destination with live search, catalog sections, details, episodes and playback.
Added a labeled randomized Narra promotion when ad inventory is unavailable, with a shared frequency cap.
Fixed top-level navigation, library history clearing and gateway-aware ad removal.
